name: Entity Submenu Block
description: Enables the creation of blocks that display submenu items as rendered content entities.
project_description:
The Entity Submenu Block provides a block that displays the current page's submenu items as rendered content entities (typically used in the “teaser” or similar view modes).

 Back to top 

 Requirements
 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 Installation
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 Configuration
 
 You can add Entity Submenu blocks at Structure → Block layout . For each block you can configure the view modes that should be used for displaying different content entity types.

 By default only menu items are rendered for content entities, but you also have the option to enable the rendering of other menu items as simple links as well.
